data.name: contactsimporter.upload.cancelmessage

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.paused
data.value: The upload is paused. Parts already uploaded stay on the server.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.worker
data.value: The file could not be processed: {{reason}}

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.rejected
data.value: The server did not accept the data: {{reason}}

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.rejectedrow
data.value: The server did not accept the data: {{reason}} (row {{row}})

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.toolarge
data.value: The file holds more data than one import can upload. Split the file into smaller files, or ask an administrator to raise the size limit of the Contacts Importer.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.network
data.value: The upload stopped because the server could not be reached. Parts already uploaded are kept; try again to continue.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.norows
data.value: No row of the file can be imported. Download the skipped rows to see why, then fix the file or the mapping.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.complete
data.value: The upload could not be finished: {{reason}}

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.duplicatestext
data.value: Clean data is expected: one row per contact. Duplicates are applied in file order (the last non-empty value wins) and the preview of new contacts may be too high. To fix it, cancel the import, clean the file and start again.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.rejectedtext
data.value: Skipped rows are not uploaded. The list of row numbers and reasons is created in your browser and is not sent to the server.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.listtruncated
data.value: The download holds the first {{amount}} rows.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.reasons.missingkey
data.value: No value in the match field

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.reasons.valuetoolong
data.value: A value is too long for its field

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.reasons.invaliddate
data.value: A date could not be read

data.name: contactsimporter.leave.message
data.value: The upload pauses when you leave. You can continue later by opening the import and selecting the same file.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.resumed_one
data.value: {{amount}} part was already on the server and was not sent again.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.resumed_other
data.value: {{amount}} parts were already on the server and were not sent again.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.unsupportedencoding
data.value: The file cannot be read with the encoding {{encoding}}. Choose another encoding.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.recordtoolarge
data.value: Row {{row}} of the file is longer than {{maxChars}} characters. The file probably has an unbalanced quote or the wrong delimiter.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.linetoolarge
data.value: Line {{row}} of the file is longer than {{maxChars}} characters.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.readfailednodetail
data.value: The file could not be read.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.itemtoolarge
data.value: Item {{row}} of the JSON array is longer than {{maxChars}} characters.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.unsupportedspreadsheet
data.value: .{{extension}} files are not supported. Save the sheet as an Excel workbook (.xlsx) or as CSV and choose that file.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.invalidjson
data.value: The file is not valid JSON (the error is at item {{item}} of the array). Fix the file or export it again.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.jsonnotarray
data.value: The JSON file must hold an array of objects ([ {…}, {…} ]). If it has one object per line, choose the NDJSON format.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.invalidzip
data.value: The zip file is damaged and cannot be read.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.zipempty
data.value: The zip file holds no data file.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.zipmultipleentries
data.value: The zip file holds {{files}} files. Put only the file to import in the zip.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.zipencrypted
data.value: The zip file is password protected. Use a zip without a password.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.unsupportedcompression
data.value: The zip file uses a compression method that cannot be read in the browser. Create the zip again with standard (deflate) compression.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.invalidxlsx
data.value: The file is not a readable Excel workbook (.xlsx). Open it in Excel and save it as .xlsx or CSV again.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.sheetnotfound
data.value: The workbook has no sheet "{{sheet}}". Choose another sheet.

data.name: contactsimporter.file.toomanyrows
data.value: The sheet has more than {{maxRows}} rows, more than Excel allows.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.invalidconfig
data.value: The mapping does not fit this file. Go back to the mapping and save it again.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.workernodetail
data.value: The file could not be processed.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.rejectednodetail
data.value: The server did not accept the data.

data.name: contactsimporter.upload.errors.completenodetail
data.value: The upload could not be finished.

data.name: contactsimporter.review.samplesintro
data.value: Up to three contacts per field, from the first rows of the file. These are examples, not all changes. The expected results report lists every row the import updates.

data.name: contactsimporter.review.samplesclearedtext
data.value: The file has an empty value for these contacts, and empty values clear fields. The contacts lose the value they have now.
